# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest published version of `copcesium` on npm receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report it privately via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Jangmyun/copcesium/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. Include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce (a minimal COPC file or URL, if relevant)
- Any known mitigations

You should receive an acknowledgement within a few days. Once a fix is available, a new version
will be published to npm and the advisory will be disclosed.

## Scope

This covers the `copcesium` library itself (`src/`). Vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies
should generally be reported upstream, but feel free to flag them here too if they affect
copcesium's usage of that dependency.
